thread:
elena: Dropped an alternate compact header for the usage dashboard that puts a small balance+forecast bar above the spend chart and a single-line token chip to the right. Figma link: <https://figma.com/s/alt-billing-header|figma>
elena: Two quick decisions we need: 1) Scope semantics: if user selects Project and there's zero project spend, should the header show project-only zeros or gracefully indicate an org fallback? 2) Invoice CTA label: keep short 'Download invoice' or be explicit 'Download invoice (PDF)'?

raj: Prefer explicit UX: show project-only numbers when data exists. If zero, show a subtle fallback row: "Org total shown (no project activity)" with an info tooltip. That reduces surprises when metrics change mid-month.
marta: Strong agree. Also surface the active scope as a small caption under the bar so it's always clear what the numbers reflect.
tyler: Design-wise: scope badge could be a muted chip reading 'Scope: Project' with a secondary tiny text 'falls back to org' when orgFallback=true. Token chip should be single-line: e.g. '42.2k tokens' with smaller denomination text inline, no wrapping.
tyler: Accessibility note: current token chip color pair is ~3.2:1 for the text. Needs >=4.5:1 for small text. I'll update the palette.
a11y-bot: Auto-check results: token chip contrast fails WCAG AA for small text. Suggest darkening text to #0f1720 or using a lighter background. Also ensure scope toggle uses aria-pressed and has a visible focus ring. Tooltip must be keyboard-accessible.
sam: Backend: easy to add fields to billingSummary: scopeSource: enum("project","org"), orgFallback: boolean, and rawTokens. That way frontend doesn't guess. Perf impact negligible.
sam: Proposed response snippet (for devs):
```
{ "billingSummary": { "amount": "123.45", "tokens": "42200", "scopeSource": "project", "orgFallback": false } }
```
natalie: On CTA copy: I think we keep the button text short ('Download invoice') and show 'PDF' in the tooltip/title. Long button labels crowd compact headers. Also update analytics event name when we change the copy so we don't lose continuity.
marta: Agreed. We'll keep visible label short and add accessible tooltip that reads 'Download invoice (PDF)'. Update docs and analytics mapping.
raj: FYI from telemetry: conversion on the CTA is low but support asks about file type. Tooltip + accessible label covers both.
elena: Plan: tyler to push contrast + badge mock, sam to add scopeSource/orgFallback to API, raj to handle analytics event mapping, marta to write the copy note in the PR, natalie to add a brief to support docs. Quick sync after mocks updated. Thanks folks. :rocket:
_meta: Design review thread about a compact billing header: deciding fallback behavior when switching scope (org vs project), token chip contrast and layout, invoice CTA copy decision, accessibility checks, and required backend fields for deterministic rendering. Action items and owners included.
